candidates.title: City station readings (hourly), Environment Monitoring Unit
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly NO2 and PM2.5 source at station level; catalog grain hourly, timestamps ts_utc, units ug/m3 stated. Candidate for the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 once access is granted.
suspected_issues: Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01, so it cannot serve the prototype window 2004-2005 (catalog airq.station_readings)
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off 2024-06-30; readings stop there, but catalog still lists the network as active (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01)
No PM10 column; only NO2 and PM2.5 (catalog columns)
Access is by request to Environment Monitoring Unit; request status unknown
No station coordinates in the catalog, so join to the Open-Meteo location is not documented

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly), Mobility Office
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly traffic source; counters described as near the monitoring stations. Catalog coverage from 2021 includes 2024-2025.
suspected_issues: Counters replaced 2024-03-18; before that counts per direction, after combined both directions; no adjustment documented and catalog has no note (wiki counter_replacement_2024)
Timestamp is ts_local (local time), while air-quality is ts_utc: timezone alignment needed
No counter-to-station mapping or distance documented in catalog
Coverage percentage for 2024-2025 unknown
Owner Mobility Office; access by request

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district), Clinical Analytics
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregated daily respiratory visit counts by district with no patient identifiers; the only clinic source the clinic data policy allows for this analysis.
suspected_issues: Catalog coverage starts 2022-01-01; covers the production window but no zero-day or closure handling documented
Respiratory diagnosis code set and version not documented in catalog
District code list and link to N1 geography not documented; district boundary changes unknown
Row count ~40,000 is low relative to 730 days by district, so zero-day representation is unknown
Small-cell suppression rule not documented

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Only register source for hourly temperature and relative humidity covering both windows; no internal station weather sensor was found in the catalog or wiki. Register purposes include prototyping and production.
suspected_issues: Register default_query points to Lisbon (38.72, -9.14); must be replaced with coordinates of the Italian city chosen as an assumption in decisions.md
Default hourly variables are temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation; relative_humidity_2m must be requested explicitly
Reanalysis is modelled grid data (~9-11 km), not a station reading
Timezone must be set to UTC to align with ts_utc of N1
Coverage for 2004-2005 is not stated in the register; verify at docs_url
